test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Bincy's mother__ kept her cards close to her chest.__

options.text: Informed that all the cards must be kept safe
Kept her purse and money by herself
Kept her plans and thoughts hidden

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"kept her cards close to her chest"** means:

 
 
• **English Meaning:** To keep one's plans, intentions, or thoughts secret. (अपने विचार, योजनाएँ या इरादे गुप्त रखना)
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** अपने विचारों, योजनाओं या इरादों को गुप्त रखना
 
 
 
• **Example:** In the meeting, she kept her cards close to her chest and did not reveal her strategy.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Decided to show more affection** (अधिक स्नेह दिखाने का निर्णय लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** After the argument, she decided to show more affection towards her friend.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Informed that all the cards must be kept safe** (सभी कार्डों को सुरक्षित रखना आवश्यक है)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher informed the students that all the cards must be kept safe for the project.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Kept her purse and money by herself** (अपना पर्स और पैसे अपने पास रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** She kept her purse and money by herself while shopping.
 
 

35:T8cf,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
